snippet.title: Vs. RetroSpecter P2: Infernadise RELEASE DATE Trailer (Friday Night Funkin' Mod)
snippet.description:
The wait is nearly over. After 4 years of being in and out of development and 2 years since its last update, Vs. RetroSpecter finally concludes with its most massive update yet. As Boyfriend, you'll be visiting the Infernalands with Girlfriend and facing off against the seven Infernalings. Many events will occur and secrets will be revealed. There's also tons of bonus content. The mod will release on Gamebanana and Gamejolt on October 3rd. A full showcase video of the mod will also be on the main YouTube channel for people to watch. See you then!

► Discord server: https://discord.gg/infernadise
► Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/retro_specter 
► Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/artist/1fAgYNgiRy5ZUInCWFtRi9
► Twitter: https://twitter.com/RetroSpecter_
► Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/retrospecter
► 2nd Alt channel: https://www.youtube.com/user/RetroHydra
► Stream VOD Channel: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCaJRsFVQd3H5nic2azF8sgw

Thumbnail Art by https://x.com/freakcat17 and https://x.com/w0lfwrathknight
